variantChange.name: btfilter-off
variantChange.source: SFINCS f3647fc source/src/sfincs_boundaries.f90 update_boundary_fluxes lines 1178-1190: btfilter < -1e-6 sets uvmean(ib)=0 every step, so the msk 3 outflow flux is only the weakly reflective head term q = ub*h with ub = -sqrt(g/h)*(zs_inside - zsb0) (lines 1115-1119); btfilter is read only at sfincs_input.f90:149 and used only in update_boundary_fluxes (lines 1038, 1178); see docs/upgrade/BRAWLEY-STABILITY-20261109.md 1.3 and 1.6 option 1. Physical basis: no downstream water to sustain an outflow jet, so the boundary memory term has no physical counterpart at an open dry outfall

boundaryFilterChange.label: SENSITIVITY boundary: btfilter = -1 (uvmean off); not tuned to observations; not for live registration
boundaryFilterChange.hypothesis: At msk 3 outflow links SFINCS adds a running mean of past flux (uvmean, gain up to btrelax/btfilter ~ 61x, ~1 h memory) to the head-driven weakly reflective flux; v2r stored boundary outflow was 2.6-4.4x the head-driven part (docs/upgrade/BRAWLEY-STABILITY-20261109.md 1.3). Turning it off leaves only the head term.
boundaryFilterChange.solver: SFINCS f3647fc source/src/sfincs_boundaries.f90 update_boundary_fluxes: q = ub*h + uvmean (line 1119); lines 1178-1190: if btfilter >= -1e-6 then uvmean = factime*q + facrel*(1-factime)*uvmean else uvmean = 0. uvmean starts at 0 (sfincs_domain.f90:1999) and no rstfile is used, so with btfilter = -1 uvmean is 0 at every step. btfilter is read at sfincs_input.f90:149 (default 60) and is used nowhere else except a NetCDF output attribute (sfincs_ncoutput.F90:1967).
boundaryFilterChange.scope: This mesh has mask 1 (643004 faces) and 3 (52 faces) only; no water-level (msk 2) or river (msk 5) boundaries, no bndfile/bzsfile/bdrfile, no wavemaker, so the change acts only on the msk 3 outflow links.
boundaryFilterChange.physicalSource: The head term is the boundary's own long-wave outflow speed sqrt(g h) times the head over the outflow cell bed; with no downstream water to sustain a jet at a dry open outfall, the memory term has no physical counterpart.
